SELECT DISTINCT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) OVER (
    PARTITION BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE
  ) AS item_count
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

SELECT DISTINCT
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS full_room_name,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    a.CITY AS city,
    a.STATE AS state,
    a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r

JOIN BUILDINGS b

JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a

WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_ROOM,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    ssu.MIT_ID,
    ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
),
component_totals AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_sqft_component
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY BUILDING_COMPONENT
)
SELECT
  f.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  f.BUILDING_NAME,
  ct.total_sqft_component AS total_square_footage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_distinct_floors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_distinct_rooms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_distinct_facility_organizations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.MIT_ID) AS total_distinct_supervisors,
  SUM(DISTINCT f.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees_summed
FROM filtered f
JOIN component_totals ct
  ON ct.BUILDING_COMPONENT = f.BUILDING_COMPONENT
LEFT JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
  ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  f.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  f.BUILDING_NAME,
  ct.total_sqft_component
ORDER BY
  f.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  f.BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND COALESCE(p.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 'N') = 'Y'
    THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
  END AS CURRENT_TERM_INDICATOR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
  ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
 AND (
      (t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y')
   OR (t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SP' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y')
 )
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND COALESCE(p.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 'N') = 'Y'
    THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
  END;

SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    t.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS distinct_tip_subjects_offered_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS distinct_materials_count,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_record_count
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    t.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY
    t.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS attribute_description,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  term_totals.total_distinct_subjects_in_term_h_group AS total_distinct_subjects_in_same_term_h_group
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h
  ON h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN (
  SELECT
    c2.TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c2.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_distinct_subjects_in_term_h_group
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2
  JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h2
    ON h2.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c2.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
  WHERE h2.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
  GROUP BY c2.TERM_CODE
) AS term_totals
  ON term_totals.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
WHERE h.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  term_totals.total_distinct_subjects_in_term_h_group
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH building_floor_span AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    (MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) - MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) + 1) AS floor_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE f.LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
),
max_floor_buildings AS (
  SELECT bld.BUILDING_KEY
  FROM building_floor_span bld
  JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count
    FROM building_floor_span
  ) m
    ON m.max_floor_count = bld.floor_count
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM max_floor_buildings mb
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = mb.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
 AND e.OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = e.OFFICE_LOCATION
 AND r.BUILDING_KEY = mb.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = LOWER(e.KRB_NAME)
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%'
  AND UPPER(e.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
ORDER BY building_name, mailing_list_name;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ed.LAST_NAME) AS distinct_responsible_faculty_last_names
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS group_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  CASE
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
    ELSE 'Hidden Members'
  END AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS distinct_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
  AND UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
    ELSE 'Hidden Members'
  END WITH ROLLUP
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 0
ORDER BY
  group_name,
  member_visibility;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
    f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM AS room_number,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS room_key,
    r.AREA AS area
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG <> ''
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    SUM(area) AS building_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY building_name
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(area) AS overall_area
  FROM base
),
rollup_rows AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    ownership_type,
    floor_number,
    room_number,
    organization_name,
    COUNT(room_key) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    GROUPING(building_name) AS g_building,
    GROUPING(floor_number) AS g_floor,
    GROUPING(room_number) AS g_room,
    GROUPING(ownership_type) AS g_owner,
    GROUPING(organization_name) AS g_org
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name
  WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN ''
    ELSE rr.building_name
  END AS building_name,
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN ''
    WHEN rr.g_floor = 1 THEN ''
    ELSE rr.floor_number
  END AS floor_number,
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN ''
    WHEN rr.g_room = 1 THEN ''
    ELSE rr.room_number
  END AS room_number,
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN ''
    WHEN rr.g_owner = 1 THEN ''
    ELSE rr.ownership_type
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN ''
    WHEN rr.g_org = 1 THEN ''
    ELSE rr.organization_name
  END AS organization_name,
  CAST(ROUND(rr.total_rooms, 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS total_rooms,
  CAST(ROUND(rr.total_area, 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS total_area,
  CASE
    WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN 100.0
    WHEN rr.g_floor = 1 AND rr.g_room = 1 AND rr.g_org = 1 THEN
      ROUND(100.0 * rr.total_area / NULLIF(ot.overall_area, 0), 2)
    ELSE
      ROUND(100.0 * rr.total_area / NULLIF(bt.building_area, 0), 2)
  END AS pct_total_area
FROM rollup_rows rr
LEFT JOIN building_totals bt
  ON bt.building_name = rr.building_name
CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN rr.g_building = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  rr.building_name,
  CAST(rr.floor_number AS UNSIGNED),
  rr.room_number;

WITH
building_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  WHERE b.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(b.CAMPUS_SECTOR) <> ''
),
addr AS (
  SELECT
    a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(a.CITY)  AS CITY,
    MAX(a.STATE) AS STATE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  GROUP BY a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
floor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.FLOOR) AS floor_cnt,
    SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)  AS floor_assignable_area
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR f
  GROUP BY f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
room_agg AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS room_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_cnt
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bb.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    bb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    ad.CITY,
    ad.STATE,
    bb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(fa.floor_cnt, 0) AS total_floors,
    COALESCE(fa.floor_assignable_area, 0) AS total_assignable_area_num,
    FORMAT(COALESCE(fa.floor_assignable_area, 0), 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(ra.room_cnt, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(ra.org_cnt, 0) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM building_base bb
  LEFT JOIN addr ad
    ON ad.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floor_agg fa
    ON fa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN room_agg ra
    ON ra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
ranked_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    br.*,
    (DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY br.CAMPUS_SECTOR
      ORDER BY br.total_assignable_area_num DESC
    ) - 1) AS area_rank
  FROM building_rows br
),
sector_totals AS (
  SELECT
    rb.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    '' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SUM(rb.total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(rb.total_assignable_area_num) AS total_assignable_area_num,
    FORMAT(SUM(rb.total_assignable_area_num), 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS distinct_organizations,
    NULL AS area_rank
  FROM ranked_buildings rb
  GROUP BY rb.CAMPUS_SECTOR
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SUM(st.total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(st.total_assignable_area_num) AS total_assignable_area_num,
    FORMAT(SUM(st.total_assignable_area_num), 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS distinct_organizations,
    NULL AS area_rank
  FROM sector_totals st
)
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  total_floors,
  total_assignable_area,
  total_rooms,
  distinct_organizations,
  area_rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    total_floors,
    total_assignable_area,
    total_rooms,
    distinct_organizations,
    area_rank
  FROM ranked_buildings

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    total_floors,
    total_assignable_area,
    total_rooms,
    distinct_organizations,
    area_rank
  FROM sector_totals

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    total_floors,
    total_assignable_area,
    total_rooms,
    distinct_organizations,
    area_rank
  FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  (x.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NULL) ASC,
  x.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  (x.area_rank IS NULL) ASC,
  x.area_rank,
  x.BUILDING_NAME_LONG;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
      fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
      fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
      b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
      fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
      fb.DATE_OCCUPIED,
      fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
      fb.SITE
  FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
  JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
),
mit AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM base
  WHERE SITE = 'MIT'
)
SELECT
  'DETAIL' AS row_type,
  BUILDING_NUMBER,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  BUILDING_TYPE,
  DATE_OCCUPIED,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  SITE,
  NULL AS metric,
  NULL AS metric_value
FROM base

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'SUMMARY' AS row_type,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'MIT',
  'OWNED' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM mit
WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'SUMMARY' AS row_type,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'MIT',
  'LEASED' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM mit
WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'LEASED'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'SUMMARY' AS row_type,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'MIT',
  'TOTAL' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM mit;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN bh.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL OR bh.BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE bh.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
    END AS ownership_group,
    bh.BUILDING_USE AS usage_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(bh.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_group_id,
    bh.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS ext_gross_area,
    bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS fclt_building_key
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh
  WHERE bh.SITE = 'MIT'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    b.ownership_group,
    b.usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.building_group_id) AS distinct_buildings,
    SUM(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN b.building_group_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.ext_gross_area
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS total_gross_sqft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS distinct_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM b
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.fclt_building_key
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  GROUP BY
    b.ownership_group,
    b.usage_type
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN a.ownership_group = 'UNKNOWN' OR a.usage_type IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ownership_group ORDER BY a.usage_type) = 1
        THEN a.ownership_group
      ELSE ''
    END AS ownership_type_display,
    a.usage_type,
    a.distinct_buildings,
    a.total_gross_sqft,
    a.distinct_rooms,
    a.distinct_organizations,
    a.ownership_group
  FROM agg a
)
SELECT
  ownership_type_display AS ownership_type,
  usage_type AS building_use,
  distinct_buildings,
  total_gross_sqft,
  distinct_rooms,
  distinct_organizations
FROM final
ORDER BY ownership_group DESC, building_use;

SELECT
  t.building_use,
  t.total_gross_sqft
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_USE AS building_use,
    SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft,
    0 AS sort_order
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'ALL' AS building_use,
    SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft,
    1 AS sort_order
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
) t
ORDER BY
  t.sort_order,
  t.building_use;

SELECT
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  CASE
    WHEN o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IN ('2','3','4','5','6') THEN CONCAT(' ', o.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    ELSE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  END AS organization_name_formatted,
  CASE
    WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE'
    ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
  END AS assignable_label,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.AREA), 0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS total_room_area,
  CAST(COALESCE(COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY), 0) AS SIGNED) AS room_count,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.AREA), 0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'
GROUP BY
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  o.ASSIGNABLE
ORDER BY
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID;

SELECT
  t.room_category,
  t.major_use_description,
  t.total_rooms,
  t.total_area,
  t.avg_room_area
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'Assignable' ELSE 'Non-assignable' END AS room_category,
    mu.DESCRIPTION AS major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area,
    0 AS sort_is_subtotal
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
    AND mu.DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'Assignable' ELSE 'Non-assignable' END,
    mu.DESCRIPTION

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'Assignable' ELSE 'Non-assignable' END AS room_category,
    'Subtotal' AS major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area,
    1 AS sort_is_subtotal
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
    AND mu.DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'Assignable' ELSE 'Non-assignable' END
) t
ORDER BY
  t.room_category,
  t.sort_is_subtotal,
  t.major_use_description;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ff.FLOOR_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR,
    ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS department_name,
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS area
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff
    ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = fr.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR, FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, department_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    NULL AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR, FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    NULL AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    CASE
      WHEN a.FLOOR IS NULL THEN 2
      WHEN a.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS floor_null_bucket,
    COALESCE(a.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, 999999) AS floor_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN a.department_name IS NULL AND a.FLOOR IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      WHEN a.department_name IS NULL AND a.FLOOR IS NULL THEN 2
      ELSE 0
    END AS dept_bucket,
    COALESCE(a.department_name, CASE WHEN a.FLOOR IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE 'SUBTOTAL' END) AS dept_sort
  FROM agg a
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN FLOOR IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN LAG(FLOOR) OVER (
        ORDER BY floor_null_bucket, floor_sort, FLOOR, dept_bucket, dept_sort
      ) = FLOOR THEN ''
      ELSE FLOOR
    END AS floor_display,
    CASE
      WHEN FLOOR IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN department_name IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE department_name
    END AS department_name,
    room_count,
    total_room_area,
    avg_room_area,
    floor_null_bucket,
    floor_sort,
    FLOOR,
    dept_bucket,
    dept_sort
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  floor_display AS floor,
  department_name,
  room_count,
  total_room_area,
  avg_room_area
FROM final
ORDER BY floor_null_bucket, floor_sort, FLOOR, dept_bucket, dept_sort;

SELECT
  o.OWNER_TYPE AS ownership_type,
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.OWNER) AS distinct_owners,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS distinct_subscribers
FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
GROUP BY o.OWNER_TYPE, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  ownership_type DESC,
  list_name;

WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_key,
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS max_enrollment,
    d.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
    ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
cat_agg AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS distinct_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(max_enrollment,0)) AS total_max_enrollment,
    CONCAT(MIN(term_code), ' - ', MAX(term_code)) AS active_period
  FROM base
  GROUP BY category_name
),
sponsor_rank AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    sponsor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY category_name
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, sponsor_name
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE sponsor_name IS NOT NULL AND sponsor_name <> ''
  GROUP BY category_name, sponsor_name
),
start_time_rank AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    session_start_time,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY category_name
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, session_start_time
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL AND session_start_time <> ''
  GROUP BY category_name, session_start_time
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT
    a.category_name AS category_label,
    a.distinct_sessions,
    a.total_max_enrollment,
    a.active_period,
    sr.sponsor_name AS most_common_sponsor_name,
    tr.session_start_time AS most_common_session_start_time
  FROM cat_agg a
  LEFT JOIN sponsor_rank sr
    ON sr.category_name = a.category_name AND sr.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN start_time_rank tr
    ON tr.category_name = a.category_name AND tr.rn = 1
),
total_row AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS category_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS distinct_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(max_enrollment,0)) AS total_max_enrollment,
    NULL AS active_period,
    NULL AS most_common_sponsor_name,
    NULL AS most_common_session_start_time
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  category_label,
  distinct_sessions,
  total_max_enrollment,
  active_period,
  most_common_sponsor_name,
  most_common_session_start_time
FROM per_category
UNION ALL
SELECT
  category_label,
  distinct_sessions,
  total_max_enrollment,
  active_period,
  most_common_sponsor_name,
  most_common_session_start_time
FROM total_row
ORDER BY category_label;

SELECT
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
  su2.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
  fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS distinct_space_count,
  SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_area,
  AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_area
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
  ON z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
 AND z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2
  ON su2.SPACE_USAGE = z.SPACE_USAGE
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
  AND sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT = '32'
  AND su2.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
GROUP BY
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  su2.SPACE_USAGE,
  fo.DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NULL
  AND su2.SPACE_USAGE IS NOT NULL
  AND fo.DLC_NAME IS NULL
)
ORDER BY
  access_level,
  usage_type,
  space_name;

SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT AS break_group,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS id,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS name,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS level,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS number,
  CASE
    WHEN hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> '' THEN 'Emeritus'
    ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
  END AS emeritus_label,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hfr2.MIT_ID)
    FROM HR_ORG_UNIT hou2
    JOIN HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hfr2
      ON hfr2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
    WHERE hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
  ) AS distinct_employer_count
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
  ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou
  ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hfr
  ON hfr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
WHERE mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
      c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
      b.BUILDING_NAME,
      t.TERM_CODE,
      t.TERM_START_DATE,
      t.TERM_END_DATE,
      DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_duration
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    term_duration,
    AVG(term_duration) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ORDER BY TERM_START_DATE
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS term_duration_moving_avg_5_terms
FROM base
ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_TITLE, BUILDING_NAME, TERM_START_DATE;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
    t.TERM_START_DATE AS term_start_date,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS building_access_level,
    r.AREA AS room_assignable_area
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    course_name,
    term_start_date,
    building_name,
    building_access_level,
    room_assignable_area,
    LAG(course_name) OVER (ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name) AS previous_course_name,
    LEAD(course_name) OVER (ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name) AS next_course_name
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  course_name,
  term_start_date,
  building_name,
  building_access_level,
  room_assignable_area,
  previous_course_name,
  next_course_name
FROM ordered
ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  END AS offer_dept_name,
  CASE
    WHEN s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 'Subtotal'
    ELSE s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
  END AS master_course_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subject_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.ISBN) AS distinct_tip_material_count
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL d
  ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m
  ON m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  (s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL) ASC,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC,
  (s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL) ASC,
  s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER ASC;

WITH course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
course_level AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    MAX(equiv_cnt) AS equiv_cnt
  FROM course_rows
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
),
dept_dim AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
    ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
dept_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cl.TERM_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
  GROUP BY cl.TERM_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
term_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    da.TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'TERM SUBTOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(da.distinct_courses_offered) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM dept_agg da
  JOIN course_level cl
    ON cl.TERM_CODE = da.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY da.TERM_CODE
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'OVERALL TOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
)
SELECT
  x.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  x.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  x.distinct_courses_offered,
  x.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
  dd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number
FROM (
  SELECT
    da.TERM_CODE,
    da.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    da.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    da.distinct_courses_offered,
    da.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    0 AS row_type
  FROM dept_agg da

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ts.TERM_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ts.distinct_courses_offered,
    ts.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    1 AS row_type
  FROM term_subtotal ts

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ot.TERM_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ot.distinct_courses_offered,
    ot.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    2 AS row_type
  FROM overall_total ot
) x
LEFT JOIN dept_dim dd
  ON dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = x.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN x.TERM_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  x.TERM_CODE,
  x.row_type,
  x.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS status_label,
    sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[0-9]{3,4}(AM|PM)$'
       AND ss.SESSION_END_TIME   REGEXP '^[0-9]{3,4}(AM|PM)$'
      THEN GREATEST(
             0,
             TIMESTAMPDIFF(
               MINUTE,
               STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
               STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME,   '%h%i%p')
             )
           )
      ELSE 0
    END AS session_minutes
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY sc
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    status_label,
    session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_session_count,
    SUM(session_minutes) AS total_session_minutes,
    AVG(session_minutes) AS avg_session_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY status_label, session_name WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
    WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN status_label
    WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE
        WHEN @prev_label = status_label THEN ''
        ELSE (@prev_label := status_label)
      END
  END AS status_total_label,
  CASE
    WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
    WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
    ELSE session_name
  END AS session_name,
  iap_session_count,
  total_session_minutes,
  avg_session_minutes
FROM (
  SELECT a.*,
         CASE
           WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 2
           WHEN status_label = 'CURRENT' THEN 0
           WHEN status_label = 'NOT CURRENT' THEN 1
           ELSE 3
         END AS sort_status,
         CASE
           WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN 1
           WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 2
           ELSE 0
         END AS sort_level
  FROM agg a
  WHERE NOT (status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NULL)
) x
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_label := '') vars
ORDER BY
  sort_status,
  sort_level,
  session_name;

WITH term_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_in_term
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
term_with_display_year AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY TERM_CODE) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN ''
      ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR
    END AS display_academic_year,
    distinct_subjects_in_term
  FROM term_subject_counts
)
SELECT
  display_academic_year AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  TERM_CODE,
  distinct_subjects_in_term AS DISTINCT_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM term_with_display_year
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  '' AS TERM_CODE,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AS DISTINCT_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN TERM_CODE = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  TERM_CODE;

WITH list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
student_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    msd.FULL_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = sp.KRB_NAME
  WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
)
SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS distinct_mailing_lists_count,
  AVG(ls.list_size) AS avg_mailing_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN student_lists sl
  ON sl.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN list_sizes ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  msd.FULL_NAME;

WITH list_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscriber_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC
),
student_dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS student_subscriber_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN SE_PERSON p
    ON LOWER(p.KRB_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = CONCAT(p.KRB_NAME, '@worker.com')
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
  GROUP BY
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
student_dept_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sdc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sdc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY sdc.student_subscriber_count DESC, sdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ) AS rn
  FROM student_dept_counts sdc
)
SELECT
  lt.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  lt.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  lt.total_subscriber_count,
  sdr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_student_department_name,
  sdr.student_subscriber_count AS top_student_department_student_count
FROM list_totals lt
LEFT JOIN student_dept_ranked sdr
  ON sdr.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lt.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND sdr.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  lt.total_subscriber_count DESC,
  lt.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  MAX(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS max_room_area,
  MAX(o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS max_organization_name,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
GROUP BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE
ORDER BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;
